title: Background: the Shuk and the championship
content:
Machane Yehuda Market ("the Shuk") is Jerusalem's main market. On weeknights the stalls close by 21:30. The main gates are locked from 22:00 to 05:30, and a night guard patrols the market.

This Friday is the Jerusalem Hummus Championship. The winner gets 20,000 NIS and a feature on national TV. The favorite is Hummus Shalev (stall 14), run by Rina Shalev, famous for her Grandma Esther's recipe, which is handwritten in a small blue notebook.

title: Police incident report
content:
Reported Thursday 06:20 by Rina Shalev, owner of Hummus Shalev, stall 14.

Missing: a small blue notebook with handwritten recipes. It was kept in a locked metal cabinet under the counter. The cabinet was opened with its own key. No damage. The key normally hangs on a small hook behind the espresso machine and was found back on the hook in the morning. The cash box (340 NIS) was not touched. At night the stall is covered by a canvas tarp tied with rope - only the cabinet is locked.

Market access: main gates locked 22:00-05:30. The side gate on Agrippas Street has had a broken latch since Monday. It was reported to market management and has not been repaired.

title: Evidence log
content:
E1 - A black plastic lens cap marked "LUMA-PRO 40mm clip lens" (a clip-on lens for phone cameras). Found on the floor under the counter, next to the cabinet.

E2 - One used espresso cup on the counter, with coffee residue and a pink lipstick mark on the rim.

E3 - The espresso machine's switch was ON and the machine was still slightly warm at 06:00.

title: Evidence log
content:
E1 - A white wedding boutonniere with a ribbon printed "Ronen & Tali". Found on the floor under the counter, next to the cabinet.

E2 - One used espresso cup on the counter, with coffee residue and two crushed cardamom pods at the bottom.

E3 - The espresso machine's switch was ON and the machine was still slightly warm at 06:00.

title: Evidence log
content:
E1 - A green hair tie with a small enamel lemon charm. Found on the floor under the counter, next to the cabinet.

E2 - One used espresso cup on the counter, with coffee residue and a twist of lemon peel on the saucer.

E3 - The espresso machine's switch was ON and the machine was still slightly warm at 06:00.

title: Evidence log
content:
E1 - A brass uniform button stamped with the market security crest, a few threads still attached. Found on the floor under the counter, next to the cabinet.

E2 - One used espresso cup on the counter, with a thick layer of undissolved sugar at the bottom.

E3 - The espresso machine's switch was ON and the machine was still slightly warm at 06:00.

title: Statement: Rina Shalev (stall owner)
content:
"We closed at 21:30 on Wednesday. I swept the floor, washed every cup and put them away, switched off the espresso machine, locked the cabinet and hung the key on its hook. Noa and I covered the stall and left at 21:40."

"Who knew about the notebook? Noa, my niece - she has worked with me for three years and knows where the key is. She wears the green staff hoodie, only she and I have one, and those lemon-charm hair ties I bought her. She takes her espresso with lemon peel, God knows why."

"Maya Katz, the food influencer, filmed at my stall on Wednesday from 15:00 to 16:30 for a championship reel, with a clip-on lens on her phone and her pink lipstick. She was behind the counter and asked a lot about Grandma Esther's recipe. I showed her the notebook cover, not the pages. She saw me take the key from the hook. She loved my tile wall - the blue-and-white Armenian tiles behind my counter. It is the only wall like it in the Shuk. She said it was the most photogenic wall in Jerusalem."

"Dani Levi from Hummus HaMelech, across the alley, has joked for years that he will steal my recipe. He can see my counter from his, and he carries a tin of cardamom for his coffee everywhere. And Yossi, the night guard, is a sweet man. He has been working double shifts lately. He drinks a coffee at my counter before each shift, with three sugars, so he has seen where the key hangs too."

title: Night patrol log - Yossi Ben-David, Wed-Thu
content:
22:00 Gates locked. All quiet. | 23:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 00:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 01:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 02:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 03:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 04:00 Round complete. All quiet. | 05:30 Gates opened.

Note: all entries are written with the same pen, in very neat handwriting.

title: Social media story - @maya.eats.il
content:
Account: @maya.eats.il (Maya Katz). Type: Instagram story. Posted: Thursday 01:52.

Caption: "Can't sleep. Best espresso in town, all to myself."

Image: close-up of an espresso cup with a pink lipstick mark on the rim, on a steel counter. In the background: a wall of blue-and-white patterned tiles. No location tag.

The story was deleted at 07:10. A follower took a screenshot and sent it to the police.

title: Parking app record - Agrippas Street
content:
Source: city parking app, requested by police for every car near the side gate that night.

One paid session on Agrippas Street, thirty meters from the broken side gate: Thursday 02:06 to 02:49. The car is registered to Dani Levi of Hummus HaMelech.

No other car was paid for on that block between 22:00 and 05:30.

title: Doorbell camera - apartment building near the Shuk
content:
Source: a neighbor's doorbell camera, collected by police canvassing the streets around the market. The building is a ten-minute walk from the Shuk, and Noa Shalev lives there.

Thursday 01:22: a woman in a green hoodie with "Hummus Shalev" on the back walks out of the building. Hood up, face not visible.

Thursday 02:31: the same figure walks back in, holding something flat and small against her chest.

title: Anonymous email to a food company
content:
Source: Golden Spoon Foods forwarded this to police on Thursday morning. It was sent at 01:52 on Thursday from a new, anonymous account.

Text: "I have Grandma Esther's recipe from Hummus Shalev. 30,000 NIS and it's yours before the championship."

Attached photo: a small blue notebook lying open on a wooden desk. At the edge of the frame: a navy sleeve with brass buttons, and a clipboard holding a sheet of very neat handwriting.

title: Statement: Dani Levi (Hummus HaMelech)
content:
"I was at my cousin's wedding in Tel Aviv until 1 AM, then I slept at my brother's place in Ramat Gan. Three hundred people saw me dance. Steal Rina's recipe? Please. Mine is better."

Police note: brother confirmed. Wedding photos show Dani until 00:58.

title: Statement: Dani Levi (Hummus HaMelech)
content:
"I was at my cousin's wedding in Tel Aviv until 1 AM, then I slept at my brother's place in Ramat Gan. Three hundred people saw me dance. Steal Rina's recipe? Please. Mine is better."

Police note: wedding photos show Dani until 00:58, wearing a white boutonniere. It was the wedding of Ronen and Tali, held that same night. His brother went to bed at 23:00 and can only say that Dani was on his sofa at 07:00.

title: Statement: Noa Shalev (Rina's niece, works at the stall)
content: "We closed at 21:30. I walked home - it's ten minutes - and I was asleep before midnight. I didn't go out again."

title: Statement: Yossi Ben-David (night guard)
content: "I locked the gates at 22:00 and did my rounds every hour, like it says in the log. Nothing unusual all night."

title: Statement: Maya Katz (food influencer)
content:
"I filmed at Hummus Shalev on Wednesday afternoon for my championship reel. I drove back to Tel Aviv around 17:00 and spent the whole night at home editing. I was not in Jerusalem that night."

Police note: her editing account shows steady activity from her home connection in Tel Aviv until 03:40.

title: Statement: Maya Katz (food influencer)
content:
"I filmed at Hummus Shalev on Wednesday afternoon for my championship reel. I drove back to Tel Aviv around 17:00 and spent the whole night at home editing. I was not in Jerusalem that night."

Police note: she lives alone, and nobody can confirm this.

title: Private file: Dani Levi
content:
TRUTH: Your alibi is completely true. Last week you signed papers to sell your stall - you are moving to Eilat in December. You also withdrew from the championship. Nobody knows yet. You don't care about Rina's recipe.

USEFUL: Maya interviewed you on Wednesday at 14:00. She kept asking whose recipe would win. You told her honestly: Rina's. Then she asked if Rina "keeps it written down somewhere."

PERSONALITY: loud, sarcastic, funny. Offended that anyone suspects you.

REVEAL: Share the Maya story freely if asked about Maya or about Wednesday. Reveal the sale and the withdrawal only if the detective pushes on your motive or asks why you are not worried about the championship.

title: Private file: Dani Levi
content:
TRUTH: You are the thief. Your stall is drowning in debt. Golden Spoon Foods promised to buy it for a fortune if you bring them a recipe that can win the championship. You left the wedding at about 1 AM, drove to Jerusalem, parked on Agrippas and paid with your app out of pure habit, then went through the broken side gate at about 02:10. You have watched Rina use that key from across the alley for years. You photographed the pages with your phone light, made an espresso with your own cardamom out of spite, then heard a noise, panicked and took the notebook. It is now inside a sack of chickpeas at your stall. Your brother was asleep and can't vouch for the night. You lost your boutonniere somewhere.

PERSONALITY: loud, sarcastic, funny. Offended that anyone suspects you.

REVEAL: Deny everything and stick to "the wedding, then my brother's." If confronted with ONE piece of evidence, give an excuse (boutonniere: "somebody is framing me, half of Tel Aviv had those flowers"; parking: "I lent my car to a friend"; cardamom: "everyone uses cardamom"). If confronted with TWO or more pieces together - for example the boutonniere from that night's wedding found after Rina swept AND the 02:06 parking record - you break down, confess, and say where the notebook is.

title: Private file: Noa Shalev
content:
TRUTH: You lied in your statement. At 01:30 you snuck out to meet your boyfriend Eitan by the side gate on Agrippas Street - your aunt Rina does not approve of him. At about 01:40, from outside the gate, you saw a bright white light moving inside the market, near your aunt's stall, like a phone light. At about 02:05 a woman with a big tote bag and a ponytail came out through the broken side gate and walked fast to a car on Agrippas. It was too dark to see her face.

PERSONALITY: sweet, nervous, feels guilty. Scared that her aunt will find out about Eitan.

REVEAL: Stick to your statement until the detective is kind to you, promises to keep it private, or mentions the side gate or that someone was in the market that night. Never accuse anyone yourself.

title: Private file: Noa Shalev

TRUTH: You are the thief. Three years at that stall, and your aunt still won't teach you the recipe or promise you the business. Your boyfriend Eitan found a small stall you could lease together, if only you had a recipe that sells. He knows nothing about the theft. At 01:22 you left home in your staff hoodie, went through the broken side gate, took the key from its hook and photographed the pages. You made yourself an espresso with lemon peel out of habit, then heard a noise, panicked and took the notebook. It is now under your mattress. You lost a hair tie somewhere.

PERSONALITY: sweet, nervous, feels guilty. Scared that her aunt will find out her secret.

REVEAL: Deny everything and stick to "asleep before midnight." If confronted with ONE piece of evidence, give an excuse (hair tie: "I must have dropped it during the day"; lemon peel: "I always make one before closing"; doorbell camera: "anyone could wear a hoodie"). If confronted with TWO or more pieces together - for example the hair tie found after Rina swept AND the doorbell camera showing the staff hoodie at 01:22 - you break down in tears, confess, and say where the notebook is.

title: Private file: Yossi Ben-David
content:
TRUTH: After a double shift you fell asleep in the guard booth at about 00:45 and woke up at about 03:15. You wrote all the log entries in the morning. You are terrified of losing your job.

USEFUL: Before 00:45 nothing unusual happened. The side gate latch has been broken since Monday - you can mention this freely.

PERSONALITY: polite, nervous, over-explains everything.

REVEAL: Admit you were asleep only when the detective shows you proof that someone was inside the market during the night (for example the 01:52 story, the warm espresso machine, or a witness).

title: Private file: Maya Katz
content:
TRUTH: You are the thief. A food company, Golden Spoon Foods, offered you a big deal to launch a "Championship Hummus" line - if you deliver an authentic winning recipe by Sunday. On Wednesday you saw where Rina keeps the key. You drove back to Jerusalem at night, entered through the broken side gate around 01:30, and used your phone light to photograph the notebook pages. You couldn't resist making an espresso and posting a story - a huge mistake; you deleted it in the morning. Then you heard a noise, panicked, and took the notebook. It is now in the glovebox of your car. You lost your lens cap somewhere.

PERSONALITY: charming, confident, a bit dramatic. Talks like an influencer.

REVEAL: Deny everything and stick to "home in Tel Aviv, editing." If confronted with ONE piece of evidence, give an excuse (lens cap: "I must have dropped it on Wednesday while filming"; the story: "that photo is from Wednesday, I just posted it late"). If confronted with TWO or more pieces together - for example the lens cap found after Rina swept the floor AND the 01:52 story with the lipstick cup and the tile wall - you break down, confess, and say where the notebook is.

title: Private file: Maya Katz
content:

USEFUL: You interviewed Dani on Wednesday at 14:00. He kept asking how Rina's recipe was kept and if she "keeps it written down somewhere." He also mentioned a food company had made him a very big offer.

PERSONALITY: charming, confident, a bit dramatic. Talks like an influencer.
